# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 鵔鸃也。从鳥義聲。秦漢之初，侍中冠鵔鸃冠。
As per 亶# (long and flat) + 鳥 bird → *bird of prey* with a flattened beak (compare 鱣). In Japanese, はやぶさ refers to a (peregrine) falcon; compare 隼.
鷐風也。从鳥亶聲。
鸑鷟，鳳屬，神鳥也。从鳥獄聲。《春秋國語》曰：“周之興也，鸑鷟鳴於岐山。”江中有鸑鷟，似鳧而大，赤目。
烏鸔也。从鳥暴聲。
鳥 bird + 嬰# for the sound alone to simulate the squawk of a *parrot*.
鸚䳇，能言鳥也。从鳥嬰聲。
鳥 bird + 雚# as described in 勸 for the sound alone to simulate the cry of a crane → (Japanese) *stork*.
鸛專，畐蹂。如䧿，短尾。射之，銜矢射人。从鳥雚聲。
An abbreviated form# of 驪 neatly aligned + 鳥 bird → birds flying in alignment. The compound 黄鸝 (黃鸝) refers to a Chinese oriole.

䜌# as described in 戀 + 鳥 bird → *imaginary bird* believed to accompany the phoenix ( 凰/鳳). 䜌normally conveys either the sense "stretch" (compare 彎 戀 攣 etc.) or "tangled" (compare 孿 蠻 變etc.); its function in 鸞 is uncertain.
亦神靈之精也。赤色，五采，雞形。鳴中五音，頌聲作則至。从鳥䜌聲。周成王時氐羌獻鸞鳥。

entries.text: A depiction of salt-studded earth → (naturally occurring) *salt*; *saline earth*; *alkali*.
西方鹹地也。从西省，象鹽形。安定有鹵縣。東方謂之㡿，西方謂之鹵。凡鹵之屬皆从鹵。

滷.example: 卤味 → 滷味; 卤素 → 鹵素
滷.evidenceScope: All examples in this note were individually reviewed against cited pinned OpenCC phrase records or identified supplementary sources. This does not establish unconditional character conversion, all regional spelling choices or full mainland-2013 certification.

lexicalEvidence.methodology: Exact version-pinned phrase records, with independently identified dictionary, composed-example or literary evidence where needed; no native OpenCC execution was performed.

鹵.example: 卤素 → 鹵素; 卤味 → 滷味
鹵.evidenceScope: All examples in this note were individually reviewed against cited pinned OpenCC phrase records or identified supplementary sources. This does not establish unconditional character conversion, all regional spelling choices or full mainland-2013 certification.

entries.text: As per 咸# (shut) + 鹵 salt/alkali → salt contained in a shut mouth (compare 鹽) → *salty* taste that causes the lips to pucker.
銜也。北方味也。从鹵咸聲。
As per 僉# (assemble) + 鹵 salt/alkali → assemble *salt* on the ground for drying → *alkaline*; *alkali*.
鹵也。从鹽省，僉聲。
As per 監# (container) + 鹵 salt/alkali → container of *salt* → *chloride*.
鹹也。从鹵監聲。古者，宿沙初作煑海鹽。凡鹽之屬皆从鹽。
A depiction of a *deer*, an animal that forms a long, winding herd.
獸也。象頭角四足之形。鳥鹿足相似，从匕。凡鹿之屬皆从鹿。
牝鹿也。从鹿，从牝省。
鹿 deer + an abbreviated form# of 票 (rise) (using the original form with 火 fire) → bounding (= rising) *deer*. For the idea of a leaping animal, compare 豹.
麠屬。从鹿，㶾省聲。
As per 禾# (round) + 鹿 (long and winding herd of) deer → species of hornless *deer* (flocking in a circular group) → *band together*.
麞也。从鹿，囷省聲。
主# master + 鹿 deer → (leader of a herd belonging to a) large species of *deer*.
麋屬。从鹿主聲。
鹿之絕有力者。从鹿幵聲。
As per 米# (concealed) + 鹿 deer → large, elusive member of the family Cervidae → *deer*.
鹿屬。从鹿米聲。麋冬至解其角。
As per 呉# (rowdy) + 鹿 deer → deer locked in combat (compare 虞 and 牾) → *hart*; *stag*; *buck* (male deer).
牝麋也。从鹿辰聲。
牝麒也。从鹿吝聲。
兒# infant + 鹿 deer → *fawn*; *young deer*.
狻麑，獸也。从鹿兒聲。

As per 其# (square/rectangular) + 鹿 deer → a *fabulous creature* said to make perfect right angles in turning. The creature is supposed to have the trunk of a deer, the tail of a cow and the hooves and mane of a horse, and to emit a multicolored glow (see 麟). The compound 麒麟 refers to the male and female of the beast, with 麒 normally understood to represent the former and 麟 the latter. 麒麟 also applies to the *giraffe*, an animal which may have been the model for the imaginary beast.
仁獸也。麋身牛尾，一角。从鹿其聲。
As per 鹿# (long and winding) + 林 forest → long and winding (forested) *foot of a mountain* or *foothill*.
守山林吏也。从林鹿聲。一曰林屬於山爲麓。《春秋傳》曰：“沙麓崩。”
麋牝者。从鹿咎聲。
The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 鹿# deer plus a pair of neatly aligned antlers (compare 羚) → *beautiful*; *lovely*.
旅行也。鹿之性，見食急則必旅行。从鹿丽聲。《禮》：麗皮納聘。蓋鹿皮也。
山羊而大者，細角。从鹿咸聲。
牡鹿。从鹿叚聲。以夏至解角。
鹿子也。从鹿弭聲。
As per 射# (shoot off an arrow) + 鹿 deer → (take aim at a) *musk deer*.
As per 章# (rise) + 鹿 deer → tall *deer*.
麋屬。从鹿章聲。

As per 粦# as described in 隣 (repeated series) + 鹿 deer → a fabulous creature reputed to emit a repeated, multi-colored glow. The creature is supposed to have the trunk of a deer, the tail of a cow and the hooves and mane of a horse, and to make perfect right angles in turning (compare 麒). The compound 麒麟 refers to the male and female of the beast, with 麒 normally understood to represent the former and 麟 the latter. 麒麟 also applies to the *giraffe*, an animal which may have been the model for the imaginary beast.
大牝鹿也。从鹿粦聲。
大鹿也。牛尾一角。从鹿畺聲。
大羊而細角。从鹿霝聲。
行超遠也。从三鹿。凡麤之屬皆从麤。

來 is a depiction of a barley plant, emphasizing the rows of pendent fruits of grain concealed in husks (compare 米). 夂 leg/foot pointed downward was added to yield a new character, 麥, meaning "come" → plant come from Central Asia. However, the meanings of 麥 and 來 were eventually inverted, so that 麥/麦 now means *barley* and 來/来 come; bring about → *wheat*; *oats*; *rye* → *grain*.
芒穀，秋穜厚薶，故謂之麥。麥，金也。金王而生，火王而死。从來，有穗者；从夊。凡麥之屬皆从麥。
堅麥也。从麥气聲。
As per 夫# (stretch out/over) + 麥 barley/grain → *bran* spread flat upon a surface → *wheat gluten bread*. A variant form, 麸, substitutes 麦 for 麥.
小麥㞕皮也。从麥夫聲。
麥末也。从麥丏聲。
包# envelop + 麥 barley/grain → *ball of (sticky) rice*.
麥甘鬻也。从麥去聲。

麯.explanation: 麯 is used for fermentation starter/yeast; 曲 remains for bends, melodies, and musical compositions.
麯.example: 酒曲 → 酒麯; 曲线 → 曲線
麯.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: 來麰，麥也。从麥牟聲。
As per 匊# (wrap about) + 麥 barley/grain → ball of grain or *malted rice* with other ingredients wrapped inside.
As per 面# (adhere) + 麥 barley/grain → sticky dough, or sticky noodles adhering to each other → *noodle* → (wheat) *flour*. A variant form, 麺, replaces 麥 with 麦.

麵.explanation: The traditional noodle/flour form is 麵 in Taiwan standard writing (e.g. 麵條); the face/surface sense remains 面. 麪條 is a variant form seen in OpenCC's basic conversion.
麵.example: 面条 → 麵條 (Taiwan writing uses 麵; 麪條 is a variant form seen in OpenCC's basic conversion); 面子 → 面子
麵.evidenceScope: All examples in this note were individually reviewed against cited pinned OpenCC phrase records or identified supplementary sources. This does not establish unconditional character conversion, all regional spelling choices or full mainland-2013 certification.
麵.usageCaveat: Specify the regional orthography rather than attributing 麵條 directly to the OpenCC base STPhrases record.

lexicalEvidence.methodology: Exact version-pinned phrase records, with independently identified dictionary, composed-example or literary evidence where needed; no native OpenCC execution was performed.

supplementarySources.finding: Headword 麵條 denotes noodles made from flour.

attestedTargets.qualification: 麵條 is a Taiwan MOE headword; the base OpenCC phrase row uses 麪條 and TWVariants records 麪→麵.

qualification.recommendation: Label 麵條 as Taiwan-supported spelling or cite Taiwan MOE directly. If citing base STPhrases, accurately report 麪條 and the separate TWVariants 麪→麵 record.

entries.text: 煑麥也。从麥豐聲。讀若馮。

The relevant seal inscription form is 广 building + 𣏟# two stalks of hemp, the fiber of which is concealed within the plant → rub and scrape *hemp* indoors → *linen*; *flax*. The 𣏟 form replaced by 林 in 麻, 摩, 磨 and 魔 is retained in other derivative characters such as 痲, 糜, 靡 and 麼.
與𣏟同。人所治，在屋下。从广从𣏟。凡麻之屬皆从麻。

As per 麻# (rub and scrape) + 幺 slender thread → *fine* (← rub/scrape fine) → *dim*; *slight*. *Interrogative particle* is a borrowed meaning. Logically, the classifier for 麼 should be 幺, but it is traditionally given as 麻.

麽.explanation: The mainland 2013 appendix lists 麽 as the traditional counterpart for 么 in the me particle sense.
麽.unchangedSense: Independent use of 么 is not an instruction to replace every occurrence.
麽.usageCaveat: Not an unconditional replacement for 么 with other readings.
麽.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

麼.explanation: 麼 is an established regional traditional spelling for the me particle, especially in Taiwan/Hong Kong conventions. It is not the traditional-character glyph printed in the 2013 mainland appendix, which uses 麽.
麼.example: 什么 → 什麼 (regional traditional spelling)
麼.usageCaveat: Retained from Unihan; not listed as the traditional glyph for 么 in the 2013 mainland appendix.
麼.evidenceScope: All examples in this note were individually reviewed against cited pinned OpenCC phrase records or identified supplementary sources. This does not establish unconditional character conversion, all regional spelling choices or full mainland-2013 certification.

entries.text: 細也。从幺麻聲。

entries.text: Abbreviated form# of 旄 pennant/banner (with a long-haired yak tail attached) + 麻 linen → (signal) *flag*; (military) *banner*; *signal*; *direct*; *lead*; *beckon*.
麻 for the sound マ + 呂 for the sound ロ to create a character pronounced まろ, used in proper names → *I*; *me*. Compare the formation method of 粂.
麻䕸也。从麻取聲。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form combines an arrow + an abbreviated form# of 光 (light extending from a torch) → flaming arrow extending through the air in flight → *yellow* (← color of the flames).
地之色也。从田从炗，炗亦聲。炗，古文光。凡黃之屬皆从黃。
白黃色也。从黃占聲。
As per 主# (stationary) + 黃 yellow → circular *yellow ornament* suspended from a crown, remaining stationary at and covering the side of the head → *yellow*. Compare 璫.
鮮明黃也。从黃圭聲。
As per 黃# (extend) and as per 𦥯 as described in 學 (obtain knowledge) → large *school*; *school building*. Compare 校.
A depiction of a tall, glutinous *millet* plant.
禾屬而黏者也。以大暑而穜，故謂之黍。从禾，雨省聲。孔子曰：“黍可爲酒，禾入水也。”凡黍之屬皆从黍。
An abbreviated form# of 犂 plow + an abbreviated form of 黍 millet → plow *dark* soil over millet seeds → *swarthy*. Also, *numerous* (← numerous seeds).
履黏也。从黍，𥝢省聲。𥝢，古文利。作履黏以黍米。
相箸也。从黍占聲。
离 here an abbreviated form# of 離 (tangle; adhere) + 黍 millet → *birdlime* (glue for catching birds) made of sticky millet.
The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 火 fire + an element# combining a chimney along with specks representing soot → *black*/*dark* (soot).
火所熏之色也。从炎，上出𡆧。𡆧，古窻字。凡黑之屬皆从黑。
As per 今# (contain) + 黑 black → *black*; *grow dark* (← be contained in darkness).
黎也。从黑今聲。秦謂民爲黔首，謂黑色也。周謂之黎民。《易》曰：“爲黔喙。”
As per 冘# as described in 沈 (sink) + 黑 black → black/dark *stain* (sunk deep into an object); *black*. Compare 黮.
滓垢也。从黑冘聲。
黃濁黑。从黑屯聲。
As per 黑# (dark) + 犬 dog/beast → silent dog, *silence* being the aural/oral counterpart of darkness → *hold one's tongue*.
犬暫逐人也。从犬黑聲。讀若墨。
淺黃黑也。从黑甘聲。讀若染繒中束緅黚。
代# alternate + 黑 black → *blackened eyebrows* (i.e., an alternate color to the natural one).
出# protrude + 黑 black (→ hard to see; invisible) → *dismiss* an ambitious (= protruding) subordinate → *demote*; *drive off/away*.
貶下也。从黑出聲。
幼 here a variant form# of the doubled 幺 element described in 幽 (obscure) + 黑 black → be obscure/dimly visible of account of blackness or darkness → *black*; *dark*; *obscure*; *dim* → *black-blue*.
微青黑色。从黑幼聲。《爾雅》曰：“地謂之黝。”
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 黑 black → black dots/marks fixed in place on a map → *dot*; *point* → *counter*.
小黑也。从黑占聲。
多# much/many (→ great degree) + 黑 black → highly lustrous *black* color → *ebony*.
黑木也。从黑多聲。丹陽有黟縣。
吉# favorable + 黑 black/dark → *cunning* that produce results favorable to oneself → *shrewd*; *crafty*. For another example where 黑 is used in a figurative and pejorative sense, compare 黨/ 党.
堅黑也。从黑吉聲。
奄# cover/conceal + 黑 black → covered and therefore *black* or *dark*.
青黑也。从黑奄聲。
As per 京# (expansive) + 黑 black → expansive dark *tattoo* on a criminal's face.
墨刑在面也。从黑京聲。
黎# dark + 黑 black (for emphasis/clarification) → *dark*; *black* (with a hint of yellow).
As per 尚# (rise → raise) + 黑 black (dark) → clandestinely raise supporters → *party*; *group*; *faction*; *fellow* → *favor*.
不鮮也。从黑尚聲。
果實黭黯黑也。从黑弇聲。
甚# extreme + 黑 black → *deep black* (an extreme color) → *dark*. Compare 黕.
桑葚之黑也。从黑甚聲。
As per 音# (indistinct) + 黑 black → *dark and gloomy* → *depressed emotions*.
深黑也。从黑音聲。
畫眉也。从黑朕聲。
淺青黑也。从黑參聲。
小黑子。从黑殹聲。
An abbreviated form# of 微 slight/fine + 黑 black → fine, black *mold*/*mildew* → *be(come) moldy/musty*. Also, *fungi* (← another form of growth).
中久雨青黑。从黑，微省聲。
大污也。从黑詹聲。
As per 厭# (press upon) + 黑 black → *mole*; *skin blemish*; *facial mole* (← dark object pressing upon/covering the skin; compare 靨).
申黑也。从黑厭聲。
Abbreviated form# of 瀆 defilement + 黑 black → *defile*; *blacken*; *sully*; *dirty/soil* (v.).
握持垢也。从黑賣聲。《易》曰：“再三黷。”
齊謂黑爲黸。从黑盧聲。
A depiction of an embroidered pattern on a long piece of cloth → *needlework*.
箴縷所紩衣。从㡀，丵省。凡黹之屬皆从黹。
衮衣山龍華蟲。黺，畫粉也。从黹，从粉省。衞宏說。
As per 犮# (split away) + 黹 needlework/embroidery → (back-to-back 弓-patterned) *embroidery*; *embroidered ceremonial robe* (compare 黼) → *(leather/cloth) lap covering*.
黑與青相次文。从黹犮聲。
As per 甫# (spread) + 黹 needlework/embroidery → *ax-patterned, black and white embroidery* → *embroidered ceremonial robe*. Compare 黻.
白與黑相次文。从黹甫聲。

A depiction of a *frog* (← creature often directly concealed by the water or vegetation to which it closely adheres; compare 鮟). 黽 is also used to refer to other kinds of amphibious creatures, especially turtles.
鼃黽也。从它，象形。𪓑頭與它頭同。凡𪓑之屬皆从𪓑。
As per 元# (round) + 黽 frog/amphibious creature → *large, roundish turtle*. Also, *snapping turtle*.
大鼈也。从𪓑元聲。
